articles.summary: WSFS Bank, the primary subsidiary of WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), today announced the appointment of Miles Herman as President of NewLane Finance, its national equipment finance subsidiary. Herman brings more than three decades of equipment finance leadership to the role and will lead NewLane's strategy, operations, and growth while deepening its alignment with the broader WSFS franchise. He will report to Jim Wechsler, Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Banking Officer at WSFS Bank. Herman joins NewLane from LEAF Commercial Capital, Inc., a leading U.S. equipment finance company and a subsidiary of MT Bank. He co-founded LEAF in 2001 and has served as its Chief Executive Officer since 2023. articles.summary: WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), the parent company of WSFS Bank, will participate at Piper Sandler’s Financial Services Conference. David Burg, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Jamie Hopkins, Executive Vice President, Chief Wealth Officer, will host discussions with investors on November 17-18, 2026, in Aventura, Florida. Presentation Materials: WSFS will present its current Investor Presentation, which is available on the Investor Relations section of WSFS’ website . About WSFS Financial Corporation WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company. Its primary subsidiary, WSFS Bank, is the oldest and largest locally headquartered bank and wealth management franchise in the Greater Philadelphia and Delaware region. As of September 30, 2026, WSFS Financial Corporation had $22.1 billion in assets on its balance sheet and $109.5 billion in assets under management and administration.
